https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/mld/mldnotifi:
- **When notification is required:** A Mold Remediation Notification is required when “mold contamination affects a total surface area of **25 contiguous square feet or more** and mold remediation will be conducted.”
- **Submission method:** “Mold remediation notifications must be submitted **online**.”
- **Standard notification timing:** The page does not state a specific number of days before the project start date for an initial, non-emergency notification.
- **Standard notification fee:** “There is a **$25 fee** to submit a mold remediation notification.”

### Emergency notifications

- **What qualifies as an emergency:** “An emergency exists if a delay in mold remediation services would increase mold contamination due to water damage.”
- **Who determines whether it is an emergency:** “The existence of an emergency is determined by the mold licensee, and not by the Department.”
- **Deadline:** “During an emergency, the mold remediation contractor or company must submit a notification **not later than the following working day after the emergency has been identified**.”
- **Emergency notification fee:** “There is a **$25 fee** to submit an emergency notification.”

### Amendment timing requirements

| Change | Required submission timing |
|---|---|
| Start-date change to a later date | “As soon as possible but **before the start-date on the most recent notice**.” |
| Start-date change to an earlier date | “At least **five calendar days before the start-date** unless an emergency notification has been submitted.” |
| Schedule changes, including work-hour changes | “As soon as possible, but no less than **one calendar day before** the most recent stop-date or the new stop-date, whichever comes first.” |
| Stop-date change | “No less than **one calendar day before** the most recent stop-date or the new stop-date, whichever comes first.” An amendment is not required if the stop-date does not change by more than one day. |
| Withdrawal of a licensed mold remediation contractor working independently, or a licensed mold remediation company, from a project | **Five calendar days.** The notification should be amended to reflect the date the contractor or company stopped work. The new contractor or company must submit a new notification “at least **five days prior to beginning work**.” |
| Addition of a licensed mold remediation company to a project | **One calendar day.** |

- **Amendment fee:** “There is **no fee** to amend a notification.”
- **Cancellation timing:** Cancellations should be submitted “as soon as possible but **before the start-date on the most recent notice**.”
- **Cancellation fee:** “There is **no fee** to cancel a notification.”

- “To purchase flood insurance, share the quote with an agent near you or you can call your insurance company or agent, the same person who sells your home or auto insurance.”
